newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: BINA PURI IN CHINA POWER VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: BINA PURI IN CHINA POWER VENTURE.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Bina Puri Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it had entered into a joint venture agreement to build and operate a power station in Yiliang County in China.
The total project cost of the power station would be 67.58 million ringgit ($24.49 million), and that it would hold 55 percent of the equity in the joint venture company, said Bina in a statement.
The other partners of the venture would be the Kunming Caishitan Reservoir Development Company and KTA Tenaga Sdn Bhd, which would hold 40 percent and five percent respectively.
Bina's total contribution to the project, amounting to around 37.17 million ringgit would be financed by bank borrowings and internally generated funds, said the company.
